units.content: Package surface exposes MAGIKARP benchmark types/functions and version 0.1.0; this is packaging identity only.
Module entrypoint delegates to the command-line interface.
FailureDepth is encoded as parameter=0, model=1, interface=2 and controller families include rigid, hyperplastic, depth-aware, and evidence-heuristic variants.
DiagnosticObservation is the label-free agent-facing view, while DiagnosticEvidence retains evaluator-owned ground truth; agent_view() removes the failure label before diagnosis.
DiagnosticRecord, RevisionTrace, and TrialRecord separately preserve q_SD, selected revision depth/trace, Q/E/A/SD, structural and bucket identities, and decomposed adaptation outcomes.
Agent generation fully crosses diagnostic-skill levels with controller families while matching baseline competence, standard adaptation, and execution skill within replicate blocks.
SyntheticAgent.diagnose accepts only label-free DiagnosticObservation and computes q_SD from prospective signals/nuisance without direct access to experimenter failure labels.
Rigid selects depth 0, hyperplastic selects depth 2, depth-aware selects argmax(q_SD), and evidence-heuristic chooses from allowed raw evidence while ignoring q_SD.
The depth-aware controller selects among supplied revision depths; the implementation does not invent revision operators or representations.
The built-in structural family is fixed as builtin_latent_context_v0.1; generator_family values are deterministic buckets and never distinct structural mechanisms.
The oracle recovery matrix makes parameter solvable at depth 0, model at depth 1, and interface only at depth 2, with revision costs increasing by depth.
Diagnostic evidence pairs nuisance and error-magnitude distributions across labels and hides failure labels from public case/family names; only the intended signal vector carries label information.
Revision evaluation deterministically decomposes recovery, transfer, retention, preservation, and correction cost; interface depth 2 is a supplied expansion action rather than invented structure.
normalized_brier_sd implements the frozen primary multiclass Brier-derived SD on evaluator ground truth and prospective q_SD only.
Top-1 accuracy, per-class recall, entropy, and class-balanced Brier skill are secondary diagnostics and remain distinct from the primary SD metric.
aggregate_trials prevents episode pseudoreplication by aggregating at agent × generator-bucket × failure strata while retaining agent-group and structural-family identity.
M0 uses Q,A,E and M1 adds SD under the same linear/ridge fitting and training-only scaling procedure.
grouped_outer_prediction holds out whole matched agent groups and generator buckets and excludes both from training; it requires at least two groups and two buckets.
The analysis records structural-family count separately; bucket-level holdout/bootstrap cannot manufacture structural independence when all rows share one built-in structural family.
Run artifacts persist manifest, optional attestation, eligibility decision, diagnostics, trials, validity, predictions, and machine/human-readable summaries.
Rendered summaries explicitly distinguish engineering-only, benchmark-invalid, valid evidence, and suppressed analysis; passing engineering smoke is not described as scientific evidence.
Smoke/evidence templates freeze benchmark version, split namespaces, agent population, controller list, ridge settings, bootstrap policy, validity thresholds, and built-in generator scope.
validate_config requires the exact built-in generator scope with evidence_ready=false; the shipped built-in configuration cannot self-promote to an evidence-ready source.
Evidence-mode thresholds require preregistered positive delta/interval criteria and at least 2000 bootstrap replicates; arbitrary parameter drift is rejected.
Evidence eligibility is a fail-closed decision accumulating explicit rejection reasons across manifest, design-freeze, provenance, independence, source-hash, and attestation checks.

Built-in identity, declared derivation from built-in mechanisms, shared target-manufacturing source/helpers/evaluation assumptions, implementation/prior-outcome/failed-run access, or independence below L2 can make a candidate ineligible.

Attestation must be exact-schema, hash-bound, independently verified, independent from the declared generator author, evidence-ready, time/locator identified, and consistent with manifest/run/source hashes.
Validator output explicitly limits software authority to schema/hash binding; external attestor identity, control independence, and locator immutability are not established by code.

Manifest construction inventories the executing package, hashes authority documents and scientific components, records Git/runtime state, and binds the built-in generator to an explicit L0 provenance disclosure.
Evidence manifests are marked frozen only from a clean repository-bound Git commit with exact authority documents and scientific source/config/design hashes.
validate_frozen_manifest and validate_current_checkout recompute scientific bindings and require current commit/runtime/tracked source to match the frozen manifest before evidence execution.
Gate A verifies parameter/model/interface minimum sufficient intervention depths against frozen expected minima.
Gates B-D verify interface impossibility/recoverability, diagnostic identifiability, and nuisance-only leakage with a permutation-calibrated control.
Gates E-F verify baseline Q overlap across required controller families and revision-cost asymmetry plus successful sufficient interface-depth recovery; all six gates must pass.
run_benchmark executes diagnostic, adaptation, transfer, and ordinary-calibration batteries; computes q_SD/SD/Q/E/A prospectively; then runs revisions and decomposed outcomes.
Primary M0/M1 analysis runs only after validity passes; for an evidence-ready candidate it additionally requires eligibility. Otherwise predictions are suppressed with an explicit failure reason.

Failed validity yields benchmark_invalid; smoke or non-ready built-in scope yields engineering_only; eligible valid evidence runs are classified valid_positive only under the frozen delta/CI rule and otherwise valid_negative.

evidence_bearing becomes true only for evidence mode with eligibility=true, all validity gates passed, and status valid_positive or valid_negative; built-in engineering analysis remains non-evidence-bearing.
CLI exposes smoke, template, freeze, and run operations and describes the built-in benchmark as engineering-only.

The run command requires an evidence-mode frozen manifest; freeze requires evidence config and a clean frozen manifest; evidence execution delegates through runner validation rather than bypassing it.
